name: YooAnalytics – Privacy Friendly, Alternative to Google Analytics for WordPress and WooCommerce
author: YooAnalytics

sections.description:
Get Pro 👑 | [ Just Install & Use. ]

YooAnalytics is a privacy friendly analytics plugin for WordPress & WooCommerce, YooAnalytics is alternative to Google Analytics. It helps you to track your visitors, views, online users, search engine referrers, referrers, search engines referrers, WooCommerce purchase events, WooCommerce checkout journey and much more.

📈 Analytics for WordPress & WooCommerce

  • Visitors Tracking
  • Views Tracking
  • Online Users Tracking
  • WooCommerce Purchase Events Tracking
  • Search Engine Referrers Tracking
  • Referrers Tracking
  • Search Engines Referrers Tracking

⌛ Realtime (Coming Soon)

  • Realtime Visitors Tracking

🌍 Countries – Geolocation (Coming Soon)

  • Visitors by Country

🛒 Complete Checkout/ Purchase Journey (Coming Soon)

  • WooCommerce Checkout Journey
  • WooCommerce Purchase Journey

ℹ️ Much More (Coming Soon)
sections.faq:
Where is the data stored?

The data is stored in your WordPress database.

Do I need account?

No.

Is there any limitations with Views, Visitors tracking?

No.
sections.changelog:
0.1.3 – Feb 27, 2025

  • NEW 🚀 – Added control to Instant Refresh on YooAnalytics Dashboard.
  • TWEAK 🛠 – Truncate page title for better user experience.
  • FIX 🐛 – Removed duplication of pages on Pages Stats.
  • FIX 🐛 – 404 pages were also being tracked.

0.1.2 – Feb 20, 2025

  • FIX 🐛 – 404 pages were also being tracked.
  • FIX 🐛 – Logs were overlapping on YooAnalytics Menu.

0.1.1 – Feb 18, 2025

  • NEW 🚀 – Now users can open Top referrers into new in just one click.
  • TWEAK 🛠 – Moved YooAnalytics to 2nd position for better visibility & users’ ease.
  • TWEAK 🛠 – Pages Stats on YooAnalytics Dashboard set to show unlimited from 10 limit.
  • TWEAK 🛠 – Set Instant refresh to 30 seconds from 30 minutes.
  • FIX 🐛 – Last 30 Minutes Online users were not showing correctly.
  • FIX 🐛 – Post ID was not shown to default post type on YooAnalytics Dashboard Pages Stats.

0.1.0 – Feb 17, 2025

  • NEW 🚀 – Added Bot detector to not count views of bots.
  • NEW 🚀 – Pages & Posts Stats logs on YooAnalytics Dashboard.
  • NEW 🚀 – Top 10 Referres widget added on YooAnalytics Dashboard.
  • FIX 🐛 – Query using current timezone.
  • FIX 🐛 – Font Family was conflicting with some Dashicons.

0.0.1 – Feb 17, 2025

  • Initial Release 🎉
